files.content:
# Immutable storage

Objects are immutable and digest pinned. Atomic publication prevents incomplete state from becoming visible.

files.title: Transaction retries
files.content:
# Transaction retries

Use a bounded retry budget when a project pointer lock is contended. Failed publication leaves the old pointer intact.

files.title: Recovery procedure
files.content:
# Recovery

A failed install preserves the previous digest. Remove temporary remnants only after validating the enabled pointer.

files.title: Storage architecture
files.description: How publication and recovery fit together
files.content:
# Storage architecture

Content-addressed objects are published before project pointers change. Recovery therefore keeps readers on the last complete version.
